limitations: The advertised actions = listener-registered + Focus for focus-bound nodes; the pin's extra Click advertisement for plain div click-listeners is not surfaced by the port's element layer yet.
Adapter creation happens at the window's a11y activation (ActivateWindowA11y), not unconditionally at Window::new — the port's a11y runtime is inert until activation.
The action drain is polled (per-frame + on demand) rather than the pin's continuously-receiving channel task — the same queue-then-dispatch semantics.
isFocused at creation reads the host's is_active (GetActiveWindow) rather than GetForegroundWindow — the foreground binding lives outside the touched files.
The native service flips its active flag on any routed WM_GETOBJECT (including object ids the adapter declines); the pin flips it only in the activation closure — mirrored and documented.
A UIA read-back client (reading the live provider tree programmatically) was not built; Narrator's real query is the read evidence, and the snapshot-model comparison is the deterministic gate.

No reference-harness a11y fixture exists in this repo (the fx family covers layout/scene/text/glyph/paths/authoring/image); the comparison basis is the ticket-21 snapshot model + the pinned source citations.
